items.summary: Financial recommendation: maintain containment-only execution. Authorize no spend, billing changes, money movement, monetization expansion, or new queue admissions. The only supported revenue result is Amazon data for 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 is unattributed; site-attributed income is $0, so site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, payback, and forecasts are unsupported. September 1-30 AI usage is $950.44 across 5,316 calls, including 229 errors, but it cannot be compared with one revenue day. AI cost-to-learn is unknown because no approved learning threshold or incremental experiment cost is recorded. Infrastructure, domain, labor, and other operating spend are unavailable; budget exposure is therefore unknown, and monthly spend, revenue, and marketing limits are blank. Minimum measurement: a dated same-period ledger matching each revenue and cost item to site/content, including AI and infrastructure allocation, plus an approved learning threshold. Continue only the existing period-aligned finance reconciliation and deployed-work measurement using available telemetry; do not extrapolate revenue or claim causal lift. Keep the allthingsmasonic.com CTA opportunity slot-gated until capacity clears and attribution remains verifiable.

Finance disposition: retain the existing period-aligned reconciliation only. Preserve the 2026-09-21 Amazon aggregate row as unattributed, keep matching-period costs, contribution margin, infrastructure spend, budget exposure, cost-to-learn, ROI, payback, and forecasts unknown, and do not create duplicate telemetry or financial work.
